1. Using the app Photogether is a camera and photo editing app. You may use it for personal and non-commercial purposes. Do not use it for anything illegal, and do not try to tamper with the app or its licensing.
2. Your photos The photos you take and edit belong to you. They are stored on your device. We do not have access to them, and we do not upload them to our servers.
3. Sample photos Sample photos come from Unsplash under the Unsplash License. See Photo credits in Settings.
4. No warranty The app is provided as is. We do our best to keep it working, but we do not guarantee that it will be free of errors or suit every device.
5. Changes We may update these terms. If you keep using the app after an update, you accept the new terms.
6. Contact Send questions through Send feedback in Settings.

Last updated: October 2026
Photogether is built to keep your data on your device.
1. Data stored on your device Your photos, edits, recipes and settings are saved on your device only. This includes the photo folder in your gallery, the app database and the preference store. Uninstalling the app removes this data.
2. Camera and storage permissions The app asks for camera access to show the viewfinder and take photos. It asks for access to images so you can open photos from your gallery in the editor. You can change permissions at any time in your device settings.
3. Internet access The app connects to the Unsplash service to load sample photos. Those requests include the app access key and are handled by Unsplash under its own privacy policy.
4. Analytics The app does not currently collect usage analytics or send personal data to us.
5. Children The app is not directed at children under 13.
6. Changes If this policy changes, we will update the date above.
7. Contact Send questions through Send feedback in Settings.
